card.name: Just before narrowing or stenosis words
card.fires_on: Words right before a narrowing term such as narrow, stenosis or stricture, e.g. 'aortic' before stenosis or 'anatomically' before narrow angles. Also fires on 'narrow' or 'restricted' describing tight passages.

modes.label: Before stenosis or stricture
modes.description: Part of a medical term or bracket that comes just before a word for narrowing of a body structure.
modes.example: particularly in patients with severe a<<ortic>> stenosis.

modes.label: Before narrow angles
modes.description: The adverb 'anatomically' right before 'narrow angles' in eye warnings.
modes.example: may trigger an angle closure attack in a patient with anatom<<ically>> narrow angles who does not have a patent

modes.label: Narrow passages in geography
modes.description: Words describing tight straits or gaps in non-medical text.
modes.example: forcibly discharged through numerous<< narrow>> straits or "spillways"

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict narrow, narrowing, narrowed and stenosis-type words next.
card.plain: It lights up when the next word is likely to be about something being narrow or narrowed.
